# Menu Render Flow — GRUB2 Theme Nuci

Details the boot menu rendering process from data to pixels.

## Flow Overview

```
grub.cfg Parse → Menu Entry List → Layout Calculation → Per-Item Render → Composition → Display
```

## Step-by-Step

### 1. Menu Entry Population

**Trigger:** GRUB2 parses `grub.cfg` (generated by `grub-mkconfig`)

**Process:**
```
For each menuentry in grub.cfg:
  1. Extract title (display text)
  2. Extract class list (--class values)
  3. Extract icon hint (if any)
  4. Create menu item object
  5. Append to menu list
```

**Data Structure:**
```
menu_item {
  title: string
  classes: string[]
  icon: texture | null
  selected: bool
}
```

### 2. Layout Calculation

**Input:** Screen resolution, theme.txt boot_menu properties

**Process:**
```
menu_left   = (left% / 100) × screen_width
menu_top    = (top% / 100) × screen_height
menu_width  = (width% / 100) × screen_width
menu_height = (height% / 100) × screen_height

For each item i:
  item_y = menu_top + i × (item_height + item_spacing)
  item_x = menu_left + item_padding
  item_width = menu_width - 2 × item_padding
```

**Clipping:** Items outside menu_height are not rendered (scroll if supported)

### 3. Background Render

**Process:**
```
1. Scale background.png to screen_width × screen_height
2. Draw to framebuffer at (0, 0)
```

**Note:** Rendered once; cached in framebuffer

### 4. Per-Item Render

For each visible menu item:

#### 4a. Selection Highlight (if selected)

```
item_bounds = (item_x, item_y, item_width, item_height)

Compose 8 sprites around bounds:
  select_n:  top edge, stretched horizontally
  select_s:  bottom edge, stretched horizontally
  select_e:  right edge, stretched vertically
  select_w:  left edge, stretched vertically
  select_ne: top-right corner
  select_nw: top-left corner
  select_se: bottom-right corner
  select_sw: bottom-left corner
  select_c:  top/bottom edge fill (horizontal)
```

**Sprite Dimensions:**
- Corners: fixed (e.g., 8×8)
- Edges: 1px wide (n/s) or 1px tall (e/w), stretched
- Center: 1px wide, stretched horizontally

#### 4b. Icon Render

```
If icon available:
  1. Scale icon to icon_width × icon_height (or auto)
  2. Draw at (item_x, item_y + (item_height - icon_height) / 2)
  3. Advance text_x = item_x + icon_width + icon_spacing
Else:
  text_x = item_x
```

#### 4c. Text Render

```
1. Set font: item_font (or global font)
2. Set colour: item_color or item_color_highlight
3. Draw title at (text_x, item_y + vertical_centre)
4. Text baseline: middle of item_height
```

**Text Truncation:** If title exceeds item_width, GRUB2 truncates with ellipsis

### 5. Label Render (Timeout)

```
1. Format text: "Booting in %d seconds" → "Booting in 5 seconds"
2. Measure text dimensions
3. Position per label block (left, top, width, align)
4. Draw text with label colour
```

**Update:** Once per second (timeout tick)

### 6. Composition

**Render Order (back to front):**
1. Background (full screen)
2. Selection highlight (behind item)
3. Icon (item left)
4. Item text (after icon)
5. Timeout label (overlay)
6. Terminal box (if active, overlay)

**Blending:** Alpha blend for all sprites and icons

### 7. Display

```
1. Render to back buffer
2. Wait for VSync
3. Swap buffers (present to display)
```

## Dirty Rect Optimisation

**Full Render:** On theme load, video mode change

**Partial Render:** On navigation, timeout tick

**Dirty Regions:**
- Previous selection highlight (invalidate)
- New selection highlight (render)
- Timeout label (invalidate + render)

**Process:**
```
1. Mark dirty rectangles
2. Re-render background in dirty regions
3. Re-render affected widgets
4. Present dirty regions only
```

## Scroll Behaviour

**When:** Menu items exceed menu_height

**GRUB2 Support:** Basic scroll (if theme supports)

**Nuci Theme:** No explicit scroll configuration; GRUB2 default behaviour

**Visual:** Items outside menu_height not visible; no scroll indicator

## Submenu Rendering

**When:** Entry has submenu (e.g., "Advanced options")

**Process:**
1. Render submenu as new menu (same layout)
2. Title shows submenu name
3. `Esc` returns to parent

**Theme Impact:** Same rendering pipeline; no special handling

## Terminal Box Overlay

**When:** User presses `c` or `e`

**Process:**
```
1. Calculate terminal box bounds (centred or configured)
2. Compose 9-slice frame:
   - Corners at 4 corners
   - Edges tiled horizontally/vertically
   - Center tiled both directions
3. Render text input area inside frame
4. Render cursor (blinking)
5. Present
```

**Interaction:** Terminal box overlays menu; menu still visible behind

## Resolution Change Handling

**Trigger:** `GRUB_GFXMODE` change, firmware mode switch

**Process:**
```
1. GRUB2 sets new video mode
2. Theme re-initialises:
   a. Re-scale background
   b. Recalculate layout (percentages → new pixels)
   c. Re-render all widgets
3. Present new frame
```

**Note:** Assets not re-decoded; only re-scaled

## Performance Profile

| Operation | Frequency | Cost |
|-----------|-----------|------|
| Background render | Once (or on mode change) | ~10 ms |
| Menu item render | Per item, on change | ~1 ms each |
| Selection highlight | On navigation | ~0.5 ms |
| Timeout label | 1 Hz | ~0.1 ms |
| Terminal box | On `c`/`e` | ~2 ms |
| Full re-render | Rare | ~50 ms |
